label: D2 after choosing a1 and landing in S2 (rare transition), late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2, and only when the agent chose a1 and the rare transition took it to S2 (in_action=a1, in_state=S2). That conjunction covers 100% of activation mass (recall 1.0), but by itself precision is only 0.30, because the feature is also gated by how late the step is in the episode: it is silent before trial ~40 and its rate climbs steadily up to trials 90-99. Adding ep_trial >= 60 gives dev P 0.67 / R 0.91 / F1 0.78 / mass recall 0.99. A near-equivalent gate is the model value output < 7.13 (F1 0.80), i.e. low expected value on those rare-a1 steps. Never fires at D1 or GO, after a2, or on common a1->S1 transitions. It fires more when S1 is the good state (so a1->S2 is the bad rare outcome), but adding good != S2 hurt F1. Magnitude is largest in windows with repeated a1->S2 rare events late in the episode. All predicate variables are observed at D2, so no future variables are used.
